# NE2213_16.0.3.520(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `NE2213_11.J.93_4930_202603032238`
> 原文: https://gauss-componentotamanual.allawnofs.com/remove-90aee5400d9c4d6feabf4ddfd66596ed/component-ota/26/04/14/9cb025beaec84a7b94f54c2f33f7d32b.html

### Luminous Rendering Engine

Adds seamless transition animations that create a more natural flow, with on-screen actions originating from and returning to their starting points within system apps.
Supports seamless drag-and-drop animations across Home screen icons, widgets, folders and Smart Sidebar for smooth, intuitive interaction.
Adds seamless transition animations when the text selection magnifier appears or disappears.
Adds seamless status bar transition animations when opening the notification drawer or Quick Settings. You can now interrupt the swipe-down gesture anytime with more seamless transitions.
Adds smooth transition animations when tapping the audio playback widget in Quick Settings for a more polished visual experience.
Supports parallel animations when launching and exiting apps from the Home screen in button navigation mode, delivering smoother transitions.
Optimises the exit animation curve for top-row app icons on the Home screen, delivering more precise control.
Optimises scrolling animation curves and touch responsiveness for the app list, delivering smoother, more responsive swiping.

### Trinity Engine

Trinity Engine delivers a smoother, more comprehensive experience. It dynamically adjusts system resources and processing loads to deliver sustained smooth performance – seamless short-video browsing, stable high-frame-rate gaming and uninterrupted photography sessions.
The system intelligently analyses key computing tasks during gameplay to ensure stable performance, while precisely managing concurrent operations like floating windows and video calls. Smart scheduling not only saves power but also delivers smooth, stable performance.
Faster photo album loading with lower power usage when loading thumbnails for longer battery life.
Improves the preview speed when viewing cached videos and thumbnails in some third-party apps for a smoother experience.
Optimises Power saving mode to adjust performance based on battery level, delivering longer battery life without compromising experience.

### AI-powered Photos

Photos gets a fresh new look and improved experience, with a redesigned photo view for smoother browsing with seamless transitions.
Optimises Photos interactions framework with clearer album categorisation and custom sorting for frequently used items, keeping everything neatly organised.
Redesigns the photo details page – swipe up to view photo info and storage location – now more intuitive and visually refined.
New video editing features, including clip cutting, merging, speed adjustment, transitions and background music. Pro-grade output, effortless editing.
Optimises video editing features, including customisable crop, rotation, parameter adjustment and filters.
Adds the motion photo collage feature, which preserves the original resolution and HDR effects of photos it uses. Plus more collage templates for greater personalisation.

### AI-powered Notes

Introduce a new content block edit mode – swipe content left or right to enter block editing mode. Easily select text, images, tables or documents with a single swipe for block formatting and quick rearrangement, faster than ever.
Adds a feature that allows you to touch and hold a photo to switch between views, along with a new side-by-side display, to improve your browsing experience.
Supports sharing notes via links. Now you can share text, images, audio and video content all at once, making it easier to share complete notes.
Supports text highlighting. Touch and hold to bold and recolour selections, streamlining note markup for efficient emphasis.
Adds multiple formatting features, including font editing, wavy underlines, dividers and text highlighting, to personalise your notes and enhance visual appeal.

### AI Recorder

The Recorder gets a complete makeover, with an optimised UI and smoother interactions.
Adds the smart naming feature, which automatically generates titles for recordings based on their content, making them easier to find and identify.
Adds AI-powered noise cancellation for human voices in recordings, significantly improving audio quality with clearer sound and more prominent voices.
New smart scenario detection capability automatically identifies recording contexts (such as meetings, lectures or interviews) and applies applicable templates for better transcripts.
Supports sharing recordings via links. You can share audio, transcript and summary together with a single tap.

### New light field design

Our new light field technology creates dynamic interplay between light and environment, mirroring light's movement and evolution for truly natural, captivating visuals.
Brings dynamic lighting effects into the system's design, elevating overall detail and texture.
Enhances Aurora visual effects, improves particle effects, glow effects, ripple effects, chromatic aberration and blending for a superior visual quality and premium interface experience.
Redesigns illustrations and diagrams for better aesthetics and readability.
Introduces the new system-wide serif font "One Serif", optimised for immersive reading with a classic, elegant aesthetic.
Introduces all-new weather visual effects – powered by Luminous Rendering Engine and real-time weather data to render realistic weather conditions with immersive effects.
Optimises the design and feel of core system interfaces like the notification drawer, Quick Settings, Setup Wizard and system upgrades for clearer information and a more refined look.
Redesigns interfaces for apps including Clock, Calculator and Compass with fresh aesthetics – now featuring real-world textures and lighting for a more delightful experience.

### Flux Home screen

New Home screen icons featuring light field-enhanced design language, with richer details and more realistic visuals.
Optimises Home screen layout grid and elements. Icons, folders and widgets now display more elegantly and are more organised.
Supports seamlessly resizing Home screen icons with dragging and adding app shortcuts for a more personalised and practical Home screen.
Supports touching and holding large folders on the Home screen to change the layout. Choose layout styles like nine-grid view, four-grid view or large icon highlighting the first app.
Introduces the textless Home screen for a cleaner, more refined look.
Improves Home screen editing mode with page reordering support.
Redesigns Drawer mode pages with the search bar moved to the bottom of the Home screen for easier app search.
The new Drawer mode allows you to swipe the index bar to quickly select apps.
Adds categorised app view in Drawer mode – apps can now be grouped by category for easier access.
Improves app recommendations in Drawer mode, featuring frequently used and recently used apps.
Redesigns the layout and style of the Home screen, Lock screen and style page with more intuitive categorisation and better layout.

### AI-powered Flux themes

Redesigns flux themes to capture everything from dramatic stills to dynamic highlights with more expressive options. AI brings out the best in reality.
Introduce Sublime Grandeur motion wallpapers – where light dances with the mountains. As clouds clear, your Lock screen transforms into a radiant sky, bathed in golden hues.
Adds motion wallpapers, bringing vibrant motion to your screen with unstoppable energy.
Introduces a new modular editing framework with real-time preview for greater editing control.
Adds custom Lock screen text. Personalise your Lock screen with any message you like.
Adds support for customising quick-access shortcuts in the bottom left-/right-hand corners of the Lock screen for faster access to frequently used features.
New flux theme icon styles adapt to your wallpaper colours with multiple customisable styles for perfect visual harmony.
Introduces new Dark mode icon styles for a more eye-friendly and comfortable experience.

### O+ Connect

Redesigns the cross-device connectivity page layout in system settings, now organised by device type and usage scenarios for clearer categorisation and easier access.

### Smart Cars

Upgrades Bluetooth connectivity with in-car devices for a better user experience.

### My Devices

The new My Devices feature, accessible from Quick Settings, allows you to view and manage your connected devices.
Adds support for My Devices widgets on your Home screen. You can add widgets for selected devices or an overview of all devices for easier management.

### Network optimisation

Network sharing now supports Wi-Fi sharing. When your phone connects to a Wi-Fi network, your tablet can share the same Wi-Fi network.
Optimises the AI LinkBoost network kernel scheduling algorithm to improve network fluency for popular apps.

### Notifications & Quick Settings

Supports more actions when editing Quick Settings tiles. More tiles now support the 2×1 size. Supports removing, adding or rearranging audio player, brightness slider, volume controls and My Devices modules.
Redesigns notifications with a more compact layout for better browsing efficiency.

### More details

Adds the option of playing ringtones only through earbuds. When this option is turned on, incoming calls will only play through connected earbuds, helping maintain quiet in public spaces.
The new AI settings page in Settings lets you easily manage all AI features.
Adds system language support for Bosnian.
Redesigns Smart Sidebar with refreshed visual styling, now supporting single/dual-column display.
Redesigns the share panel layout to show contacts directly and allow editing app shortcuts for faster sharing.
Streamlines banner notifications – menu buttons now open apps in floating windows instead of full screen for a cleaner experience.
Upgrades the battery page with improved data visualisation. Now shows foreground/background activity times for more accurate power usage statistics.
Upgrades data transfer speed and experience when migrating data from iOS to OnePlus devices.

### Others

Supports touching and holding app icons on the Home screen to lock or hide them.

Updates for customised devices

This update includes one or more of the following: apps, wallpapers, ringtones, startup animations, Home screen layout and network settings.

To view more or join a discussion, visit
https://community.oneplus.com

###

Must-knows

1. If you encounter any problems when using the new version, please contact our customer service.
2. The update package will be deleted after being installed.

# NE2213_15.0.0.700(EX01)

> 官方更新日志 · 来源: 官方 changelog 页面
> OTA 指纹: `NE2213_11.H.84_3840_202503211551`
> 原文: https://gauss-componentotamanual.allawnofs.com/remove-ee105011d52bd2387ab88e5062981c63/component-ota/25/04/23/9fff934dd7c7432d84cd8cddbc6b9208.html

### Ultra animation effects

Introduces the industry's first parallel rendering architecture, offering parallel response and unified rendering to elevate multi-app switching to a new level. Even under extreme usage conditions, the display remains consistently smooth and seamless, ensuring unwavering stability.
Adds parallel animation for a wider range of scenarios, including widgets, components, folders and more, ensuring smooth animations even when frequently interrupted.
Adds system-level swiping curve coverage for third-party apps, including WebView interfaces, ensuring a consistent scrolling experience throughout the system.

### Luminous rendering effects

Optimises the rounded corner design by standardising its specifications and extending the application of a continuous curvature.
Adds an option to rename an app group by touching and holding its shortcut on the Home screen.
The dock can now display 5 apps even when the Home screen is set to display 4 apps per row.

### Flux themes

Introduces new flux themes with a huge collection of high-quality themes. Customise them with system wallpapers and photos for your unique touch.
Introduces customisation for Always-On Display, the Lock screen and the Home screen. Always-On Display supports flux and classic modes. The Lock screen supports clock colour blending, blurred wallpapers, AI depth effects, AI auto-fills and more. The Home screen supports blurred wallpapers and more.
Introduces flux themes with one-take transition animations, enabling seamless and smooth transitions between Always-On Display, Lock screen and Home screen, significantly enhancing visual continuity.

### Live Alerts

Adds a new Live Alerts design that is focused on the visualisation of information, offering better information display efficiency. Live Alerts is also positioned in the centre, creating a more balanced display.
Optimises the way you interact with Live Alerts capsules –  just tap a capsule and see it expand into a card. You can quickly switch between multiple live activities simply by swiping left or right on the capsules in the status bar, making it more efficient to view information.
Introduces a new Live Alerts animation system featuring elastic design, seamless expansion and dynamic real-time blur to enhance the visuals of cards.
Now you can see the status of the torch on Live Alerts.
Fixes a display issue with existing icons on the status bar when a Live Alerts capsule is displayed.
Improves the layout of Spotify on Live Alerts and adds smart recommendations.

### Photo editing

Introduces globally reversible photo editing capability that remembers the settings for your previous edits so they can be applied to subsequent edits, keeping the creative flow uninterrupted.
Improves integration between Camera and filters, so filters that are applied to photos when taken can be edited, changed and removed later in Photos.

### Floating Window and Split View

Introduces new Floating Window gestures: pulling down a notification banner to bring up a floating window, pulling down a floating window for full screen display, swiping up to close a floating window and swiping to a side to hide a floating window.
Now you can drag a floating window to change it to full screen.
Introduces resizable Split View windows. Simply drag the divider to resize the window not fully displayed for a larger display area. You can also achieve this by tapping the window.

### Notifications & Quick Settings

Adds the Split mode for the notification drawer and Quick Settings. Swipe down from the upper-left to open the notification drawer, swipe down from the upper-right for Quick Settings and swipe left or right to switch between them.
Redesigns Quick Settings with an optimised layout that offers more appealing and consistent visuals and more refined and rich animations.

### OnePlus Share

The new file transfer capability with iOS devices, easily connecting and sharing files through OnePlus Share.
Now you can easily share live photos with nearby iOS devices.

### Battery & charging

Introduces "Charging limit" to stop charging at 80% to extend battery lifespan and slow down degradation.
Introduces battery protection reminder to turn on Charging limit when your device is connected to a charger for too long.

### More

Introduces exclusive OxygenOS Always-On Displays and Lock screen clock styles.
Introduces the new Home screen clock widget that can be resized to your preference.
Plants a "1+" easter egg in Calculator to be displayed when punching in "1+=" as a show of OnePlus' "Never Settle" philosophy.
Introduces more wallpapers to bring the unique style of OnePlus to your phone.
Introduces exclusive OxygenOS app icon styles.
Now you can swipe up to the left to quickly enable Split View when an app is displayed in full screen.
Now you can migrate live photos from iOS devices with Clone Phone.
Retouch appearance in video calls now supports more apps.
Boarding passes can now be recognised in Photos and added to Google Wallet.
Optimises the style and visuals of the Notes widgets on the Home screen for a more attractive and practical experience.
Apps in large folders can now be displayed in 3 × 3 grids.
Optimizes the widgets of Clock on the Home screen.
Optimizes the widgets of Notes on the Home screen.
Optimises your multitasking experience by navigating you to the last used app once you enter the recent tasks view, making app switching more convenient.
Optimises the Drawer mode by retaining the Home screen app layout when you enter Drawer mode for the first time.

### Privacy protection

Improves Private Safe with the new categorised browsing features for images, videos and documents, making it easier to manage private data.
Introduces a new Home screen entry for hidden apps. You can tap the Hidden apps folder on the Home screen and verify your privacy password to see the apps.

Updates for customised devices

This update includes one or more of the following: apps, wallpapers, ringtones, startup animations, Home screen layout and network settings.

To view more or join a discussion, visit
https://community.oneplus.com

###

Must-knows

1. If you encounter any problems when using the new version, please contact our customer service.
2. The update package will be deleted after being installed.
